integrity: Analytic derivation plus 47 reproducible numerical diagnostics; numerical checks are not exhaustive mathematical proofs.
scientific_limitations: Two iid uniform nodes on [0,1], Gaussian squared-exponential kernel, fixed alpha>0, independent nonzero Gaussian observation noise. The noiseless boundedness statement assumes a fixed Lipschitz integrand. The nugget limit refers to noise amplification, with the complete error statement for zero integrand only. Independent review not performed.
title: Collision Cauchy tails and a sharp square-root nugget cost in two-node Gaussian kernel quadrature
